8 ارتشم , in the copies of the K erroneously written ↓ أَرْشَمَ , [is expl. as meaning] He stamped, or sealed, his vessel with the رَوْشَم: thus in the saying of El-Aashà, as some relate it, “وَصَلَّى عَلَى دَنِّهَا وَٱرْتَشَمْ
” but accord. to others, وَٱرْتَسَمْ. (TA. [See art. رسم.])
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
